task_groups.title: Implement JSONL streaming progress events via ProgressDisplay

subtasks.title: Add emit_progress() method to OutputManager for JSONL stderr output
details: Add `emit_progress(self, event: dict)` to OutputManager in agentfox/io/output.py
Serialize event to a single JSON line and write to self.stderr (not stdout)
Wrap the write+flush in a try/except OSError (covers BrokenPipeError) and suppress — do not propagate
Only write in json_mode; silently no-op when json_mode=False

subtasks.title: Update ProgressDisplay to call emit_progress() in json_mode and Rich UI otherwise
details: In ProgressDisplay (wherever it lives in agentfox.io or af/), add task_started(node_id), task_completed(node_id), task_failed(node_id, error) methods
json_mode=True path: build event dict with 'event', 'node_id', 'timestamp' (datetime.utcnow().isoformat()+'Z'); for task_completed add 'duration_s'; call om.emit_progress(event)
json_mode=False path: use Rich Progress/spinner — do NOT call emit_progress
node_id=None or empty: emit event with node_id=null and write a warning line to stderr (e.g. 'WARNING: node_id missing')

subtasks.title: Wire ProgressDisplay into af/code.py and af/night_shift.py
details: In af/code.py: instantiate ProgressDisplay(output_manager=om, json_mode=om.json_mode) and pass to the execution engine
Call pd.task_started(node_id), pd.task_completed(node_id) or pd.task_failed(node_id, error) for each task lifecycle transition
Repeat for af/night_shift.py with the same pattern
Ensure the final result dict is emitted via om.emit() only after all task events have been sent
